text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible loading zone operating from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Ruskin Avenue, between a point 36.8 metres west of Franklin Avenue and a point 11 metres further west.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone, operating from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Ruskin Avenue, between a point 36.8 metres west of Franklin Avenue and a point 11 metres further west.
